description: This PHP class 'TimesheetMenuConfigurator' configures the menu screen for the timesheet module within the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the screen based on whether the user is viewing their own timesheet or another employee's, leveraging traits for controller, service, and role management.

classes.name: TimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu display for the timesheet module based on user roles and context within the OrangeHRM HRIS system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen display for timesheets depending on whether the user is viewing their own or another employee's timesheet.
